record.dic_text:
02361 Chuwram {khoo-rawm'}

可能源自 02353; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Huram 12, variant 1; 13

戶蘭 = "出身高貴"
1) 比拉的眾子之一, 便雅憫的孫子 (#代上 8:5|)
2) 大衛王和所羅門王的盟拜推羅王; 又稱為 '希蘭'
3) 所羅門王建殿工程中的一位首席工匠; 又稱 '希蘭' (#代下 4:11,16|)
record.edic_text:
02361 Chuwram {khoo-rawm'}

probably from 02353;; n pr m

AV - Huram 12, variant 1; 13

Huram = "noble born"
1) son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin
2) king of Tyre allied with David and Solomon; alternate spelling for
   'Hiram'
3) a chief architect of Solomon's temple; alternate spelling for
   'Hiram'
